title: exudev scripts --fix: AddRigidBody to mbs.CreateRigidBody
author: Claude-JG
description: Many old scripts use AddRigidBody, to be replaced by CreateRigidBody; the return values differ ([nodeNumber, bodyNumber] against the body) - the node read with mbs.GetObject(body)['nodeNumber'] - and the arguments are named differently
releaseNotes: exudev scripts --fix replaces AddRigidBody by mbs.CreateRigidBody with the arguments renamed and rotationParameters converted; the node of the returned list is read with mbs.GetObject(body)['nodeNumber']. revision2026c step RG10.31.12
